name: split-reveal
title: Split Reveal
description: Masks text and reveals lines, words, or characters on mount or scroll. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

usage.label: React

props.name: text
props.description: The text content to display and animate.

props.name: mode
props.description: How to split the text for reveal animation.

props.name: delay
props.description: Initial delay in seconds before animation starts (not for scroll-triggered).

props.name: trigger-on-scroll
props.description: Whether to trigger reveal when element scrolls into view.

props.name: scroll-element
props.description: CSS selector for scrollable container (defaults to window).

props.name: duration
props.description: Animation duration in seconds (0 = auto based on mode).

props.name: stagger
props.description: Stagger delay between split items in seconds (0 = auto based on mode).
